lines.text: Before we finish, I want to make one thing clear.
No programme, deadline, or job, is more important than somebody's safety.
If you don't understand the task, haven't been briefed, don't have the correct equipment, or think something isn't safe... don't carry on, and hope for the best.
Stop, and speak to your supervisor.
We expect everyone working for C.W.P. to look after themselves, and the people around them.
If we all follow the correct procedures, communicate properly, and deal with problems when they arise, we can get the job done safely.
Has anyone got any questions, before we go through the site-specific arrangements?
